title: Precomposition on module-valued total Hom complexes
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $P,R,T$ integer-indexed cochain complexes of $A$-modules, with a chain map $f:P\to R$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For the $A$-module-valued total Hom complexes [def-sc-module-total-hom-complex], define the precomposition chain map $f^*:\operatorname{Hom}_A^\bullet(R,T)\to\operatorname{Hom}_A^\bullet(P,T)$ as follows. Its degree-$j$ component is the $A$-linear map sending a homogeneous cochain $\varphi=(\varphi^p)_p$ to $(\varphi^p\circ f^p)_p$. These components commute with the total Hom differential $D\varphi=d_T\varphi-(-1)^j\varphi d$, so they specify a morphism of cochain complexes. No boundedness or injectivity hypothesis is imposed.
